corrections.why: The Forest Fire Lookout Association list has this site as Platform, Abandoned. It was a camp platform that never had a permanent tower, and no source says a structure stood and was removed.

notes_for_editor: Three sources agree on the c.1939 camp with a platform tower, the national forest land and the summit access. None names a staff member, a fire, or what happened to the platform, so those are left out. Brief status 'gone' corrected to 'abandoned' using the Forest Fire Lookout Association list. No height in any source, so height_m is omitted. Brief access 'unknown' is filled as public, because national forest land and a road to the summit area are described. Photo captions are quoted as observations, not as a dated survey. Read budget: 3 page reads plus one search and the firelookout.org index. The search turned up a Forest Service photo collection (washingtonruralheritage.org) that I did not open; it may hold a dated photo or staffing record for the editor to check.
